title: observability-weekly-2026-07-06
body:
Observability team weekly notes - 2026-07-06

TL;DR:
- Tracing rollout to prod canary cluster completed for frontend services (canary traffic only). Initial sampling and tag propagation look good.
- Dashboard refresh: New cost-per-model dashboard v1 deployed to Grafana; still iterating on label normalization.
- Cost telemetry pipeline: fixed delayed ingestion issue (k8s job retries causing backfill). Monitoring alerts added.
- Two open action items: 1) finalize SLO target for embeddings pipeline, 2) add KV-cache span annotations for runtime ops.

Standup highlights (this week):
- Mon: Tracing instrumentation sweep for frontend + auth services. Found 3 spots missing context propagation header (fixed in auth middleware).
- Tue: Load test with 50 RPS on canary - tail latency stable; trace sizes increased ~8% due to new dbx span. Working on span compression in runtime.
- Wed: Cost pipeline incident (see below).
- Thu: Dashboard review with finance - requested per-model granularity and allocation by customer tags.
- Fri: Sprint retro + planning for next 2 weeks.

Tracing & Instrumentation:
- What shipped: canary rollout of tracing v2 agent to frontend-canary cluster. Agent now tags traces with model_id and route_id.
- Metrics observed: spans-per-request up ~6-10% on complex chat flows (expected). End-to-end trace time P95 unchanged.
- Outstanding work: add KV-cache span annotation (ticket OBS-4190) so we can correlate cache hit/miss to request latency.
- Risks/Notes: span cardinality on model_id needs normalization to avoid high-cardinality burden on backend; agreed to bucket model versions (major.minor) before emitting tag.

Dashboards & Visualizations:
- New dashboard: cost-per-model-v1 (Grafana) deployed to production org dashboard folder. Shows token_cost, CPU_seconds, GPU_seconds per model per hour.
- Known issues: label normalization - some customers emit custom_model_tag that creates duplicates. Plan: apply normalization mapping in the ETL stage (PR in observability repo).
- UX requests from finance: add export to CSV and hourly aggregation toggle. Filed task: OBS-4211.

Cost Telemetry & Pipeline:
- Incident (2026-07-02): delayed ingestion from k8s job controller due to exponential backoff misconfig on the cost-collector job. Root cause: backoff maxRetries set too high; batch window overlapped with next run causing DB unique key conflicts and retries.
  - Mitigation: disabled backoff, added jitter, and increased idempotency keys. Backfill job completed on 2026-07-04.
  - Postmortem plan: add stricter unit tests for job idempotency, instrument job metrics and alerts for queue lag > 5m. (See JIRA OBS-4123)
- Ongoing: align cost attribution to customer tags - working with billing team to standardize tag set.

SLOs, Alerts & Reliability:
- SLO review: embeddings inference pipeline SLO proposal (P95 latency 150ms) under discussion - need sign-off from product and infra.
- Alerts: created new alert for cost-pipeline-lag and tracing-agent-error-rate > 1% for 5m. De-duplicated noisy alert for high-cardinality labels.

Meetings / Syncs:
- Wed 10:00am - Incident review (cost pipeline) - attendees: eng-observability, infra, billing. Outcome: short-term fixes deployed; follow-up retro scheduled.
- Thu 2:00pm - Dashboard handoff with finance - attendees: product-hosted-api, finance-analytics. Outcome: finance asked for per-customer allocations and month-to-date vs month-ago comparisons.
- Fri 3:00pm - Runbook review for tracing agent failures - added new runbook steps for agent restart and trace sink failover.

Action items (owners):
- Aisha: finalize SLO proposal doc for embeddings pipeline and circulate to product (due 2026-07-10).
- Jorge: PR for span compression in runtime (github.com/redwood-inference/observability PR#224) - aim to merge by 2026-07-08.
- Sofia: implement label normalization mapping in ETL (OBS-4211) - WIP.
- Ethan: add KV-cache span annotations and update trace schema (OBS-4190) - blocked by runtime changes, expected next week.

Blockers:
- Runtime change required to expose KV-cache annotation (blocks span-based cache analysis). Need infra window to deploy runtime patch.
- Finance needs finalized model tag mapping for full cost allocation; until mapping is finalized dashboard has incomplete rows.

Notes / Questions for leadership:
- Is product comfortable with proposed embeddings SLO (P95 150ms)? This will impact resource allocation and cost.
- Approve an additional infra maintenance window next week for runtime rollout (necessary for KV-cache spans).

Misc / Notes to self:
- Add quick-start snippet to Confluence page showing how to add trace annotations in Go/Node services.
- Follow up on noisy alert tuning - reduce notification blast by grouping by service owner.

Appendix: quick links
- Incident postmortem draft: https://confluence.redwood.com/pages/OBS-cost-pipeline-postmortem
- Tracing rollout doc: https://confluence.redwood.com/pages/OBS-tracing-rollout
- Dashboards: grafana.redwood.com/d/obs/cost-per-model-v1
summary: Canary tracing deployed; cost ingestion incident mitigated; dashboards iterating; action items assigned.
